verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like Wave, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack, which covers invoicing, payments, payroll, receipts, pricing and API probes, mentions telemetry, analytics or tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
